metadata.source: MediaWiki "Past finalists" wikitable for "George Washington Book Prize"
metadata.notes: Official Gilder Lehrman and Mount Vernon award pages return HTTP 403 to automated fetches (Cloudflare), so the cited Wikipedia table is used as a secondary source. Rows flagged with the {{blue ribbon}} template are recorded as winners; every other row in the year block is a finalist. The year cell is blank on continuation rows and is carried forward from the preceding row. The 2015 Special Achievement Award to the musical Hamilton is excluded because it is not a book. Official awards URL: https://www.gilderlehrman.org/book-prizes/washington
